q: Irúfẹ́ ọ̀rọ̀-asojú-orúkọ wo ni 'Èmi'?
explanation: 'Èmi' is an independent (emphatic) pronoun used to refer to the speaker in the first person singular.

q: Kí ni iṣẹ́ 'ẹ̀mí' nínú ìpín mẹ́ta tí Yorùbá pín ènìyàn sí?
opts: Láti fún ènìyàn ní ìjìnlẹ̀ òye
Láti yan orí ní àjálá mọpin
explanation: In Yoruba metaphysics, the 'Ẹ̀mí' (soul/breath) is the life-giving force provided by Olodumare that animates the 'Ara' (body).

q: Báwo ni a ṣe ń kọ 'emi' pẹ̀lú àmì ohùn tí ó tọ́ bí ó bá dúró fún 'breath of life'?
explanation: The word for soul or spirit is written as 'Ẹ̀mí' with a low tone on 'Ẹ' and a high tone on 'i'.

q: Inú fọ́nẹ́tíìkì, 'e' ati 'ẹ' jẹ́ fọ́wẹ́lì _____.
explanation: 'e' and 'ẹ' are oral vowels (fọ́wẹ́lì àìránmú) because air flows only through the mouth during their production.

q: Kí ni ìyàtọ̀ láàárín 'Èmi' àti 'Mo' nínú gírámà Yorùbá?
opts: Èmi jẹ́ fún ìtẹnumọ́, Mo jẹ́ asojú-orúkọ lásán
Mo jẹ́ fún ìtẹnumọ́, Èmi jẹ́ asojú-orúkọ lásán
Èmi ni a ń lò lẹ́yìn ọ̀rọ̀-ìṣe
explanation: 'Èmi' is the emphatic/strong form of the first-person singular pronoun, while 'Mo' is the short/clitic form used as a subject.

q: Nínú àsà Yorùbá, ta ni ẹni tí ń mọ 'Ara'?
explanation: Obatala is the deity responsible for molding the physical body (Ara) from clay.

q: Parí òwe yìí: 'Ẹ̀mí m' bẹ, _____ m' bẹ'.
explanation: The proverb 'Ẹ̀mí m' bẹ, ìtura m' bẹ' implies that as long as there is life, there is hope for comfort/relief.

q: Àpólà-ọ̀rọ̀ wo ni 'Èmi tìkarami'?
explanation: 'Èmi tìkarami' (I, myself) functions as a noun phrase (Àpólà-orúkọ) focusing on the subject.

q: Kí ni iṣẹ́ fáwẹ́lì nínú ọ̀rọ̀ Yorùbá?
explanation: Vowels are the nucleus of syllables in Yoruba; every syllable must contain a vowel to carry a tone.

q: Mélòó ni fáwẹ́lì àránmú nínú èdè Yorùbá?
explanation: There are five nasal vowels in standard Yoruba: an, ẹn, in, ọn, un.

q: Èwo nínú àwọn wọ̀nyí ni kì í ṣe kọ́nṣónáǹtì nínú èdè Yorùbá?
explanation: The letter 'c' does not exist in the Yoruba alphabet; its sound is usually represented by 's' or 'ṣ'.

q: Kí ni Yorùbá ń pè ní 'Ẹ̀fọ̀n'?
explanation: 'Ẹ̀fọ̀n' is the Yoruba name for a Buffalo.

q: Nínú lítíréṣọ̀ àtẹnudẹ́nu, kí ni 'Àlọ̀ Àpagbe'?
explanation: Àlọ̀ Àpagbe refers to folktales that involve songs where the audience joins in the chorus.

q: Ta ni akọni nínú ìwé 'Ògbójú Ọdẹ nínú Igbó Irúnmalẹ̀'?
explanation: Akara-oogun is the central protagonist in D.O. Fagunwa's famous novel.

q: Kí ni orúkọ àmì ohùn orí 'i' nínú ọ̀rọ̀ 'mì'?
explanation: The low tone marks (`) are called Àmì-ìsàlẹ̀ or Àmì-dò.

q: Èwo nínú àwọn wọ̀nyí ni ó jẹ́ àmì-ìdánimọ̀ fún 'Ẹ̀mí' nínú èdè Yorùbá?
explanation: Breathing (Mímí) is the physical manifestation of the presence of 'Ẹ̀mí' (the soul/life force).

q: Kí ni 'Ọmọ-olórí-ire' nínú àṣà Yorùbá?
opts: Ọmọ tí ó ní owó lọ́wọ́
explanation: An 'olórí-ire' is someone believed to have chosen a good 'Ori' (destiny/inner head) before coming to earth.

q: Báwo ni a ṣe ń pè 'Pronoun' ní èdè Yorùbá?
explanation: The word for Pronoun is Ọ̀rọ̀-asojú-orúkọ (a word that stands in for a name).

q: Nínú lítíréṣọ̀ àtinúdá, ta ni ó kọ 'Ẹfúnsetán Aníwúrà'?
explanation: The historical drama 'Efunsetan Aniwura' was written by Professor Akinwunmi Isola.

q: Kí ni iṣẹ́-oògùn 'Èmi' nínú gírámà?
explanation: 'Èmi' is the first-person singular (ẹni kìn-ín-ní ẹyọ) pronoun.

content: Ẹ̀mí ènìyàn kò ní kú. Bí ara bá kú, ẹ̀mí á padà sí ọ̀dọ̀ Ẹlẹ́dàá rẹ̀. Yorùbá gbàgbọ́ pé ayé ni ọjà, ọ̀run ni ilé. Ohun tí ènìyàn bá ṣe ní ayé ni yóò lọ sọ ní ọ̀run. Èyí ni ó jẹ́ kí àwọn àgbà máa sọ pé 'Ìwà lẹ̀ṣìn ènìyàn'. Bí ènìyàn bá ní ìwà rere, ẹ̀mí rẹ̀ á sinmi lẹ́yìn ikú.

questions.q: Gẹ́gẹ́ bí nkan tí o kà, kí ni ń ṣẹlẹ̀ sí ẹ̀mí lẹ́yìn ikú?
opts: Ó ń padà sí ọ̀dọ̀ Ẹlẹ́dàá
questions.explanation: The passage states that when the body dies, the soul (ẹ̀mí) returns to the Creator (Ẹlẹ́dàá).

questions.q: Kí ni ìtumọ̀ 'Ayé ni ọjà, ọ̀run ni ilé'?
opts: Ayé jẹ́ ibi tí a ti ń tajà
Ayé jẹ́ ibi ìgbà díẹ̀, ọ̀run ni ibùgbé títí ayé
questions.explanation: This is a philosophical proverb meaning earth is a temporary marketplace while heaven is our true home.

questions.q: Kí ni ohun tí ó ṣe pàtàkì jù nínú ìrìn-àjò ẹ̀mí gẹ́gẹ́ bí passage yìí ṣe sọ?
questions.explanation: The passage emphasizes 'Ìwà' (character) as the most important thing for the soul's rest.

q: Èwo ni 'Nasal Vowel' nínú àwọn wọ̀nyí?
explanation: 'in' is a nasal vowel in Yoruba phonology.

q: Kí ni ohun tí a ń lò láti fi kọ àmì ohùn 're' nínú gírámà Yorùbá?
explanation: The mid-tone (re) is typically left unmarked in Yoruba orthography.

q: Ta ni Olúwa 'Ẹ̀mí' nínú ìgbàgbọ́ Yorùbá?
explanation: Olodumare (God) is the supreme giver and owner of the soul (Ẹ̀mí).

q: Mélòó ni kọ́nṣónáǹtì Yorùbá?
explanation: There are 18 consonants in the standard Yoruba alphabet (b, d, f, g, gb, h, j, k, l, m, n, p, r, s, ṣ, t, w, y).

q: Kí ni iṣẹ́ 'ẹ̀mí' nínú gírámà nígbà tí a bá ń sọ̀rọ̀ nípa 'I'?
explanation: When referring to 'I', 'Èmi' is the first-person singular pronoun.

q: Nínú 'Ogboju Ode', ta ni a mọ̀ sí 'ẹni tí ó ní ìyá méjì'?
explanation: This refers to the protagonist Akara-oogun in Fagunwa's literature.

q: Kí ni ìtumọ̀ 'Ààyè'?
explanation: 'Ààyè' refers to being alive or a living space where life exists.

q: Kí ni Yorùbá ń pè ní 'Syllable'?
explanation: Yoruba language uses 'Sílẹ́bù' for Syllable.

q: Mélòó ni fáwẹ́lì inú èdè Yorùbá lápapọ̀?
explanation: Standard Yoruba has 12-13 vowels depending on dialect counting: 7 oral (a, e, ẹ, i, o, ọ, u) and 5 nasal (an, ẹn, in, ọn, un).

q: Kí ni orúkọ fáwẹ́lì tí a ń pè ní 'ẹ'?
explanation: 'ẹ' is a front, half-open vowel (iwájú, kéré-díẹ̀).

q: Èwo nínú àwọn wọ̀nyí ni kì í ṣe ọ̀nà ìpè kọ́nṣónáǹtì?
explanation: 'gb' is a consonant itself, not a place or manner of articulation.

q: Inú 'Sàngó', àmì ohùn wo ni ó wà lórí 'o'?
explanation: In Sàngó, the 'o' carries a high tone (Mi).

q: Kí ni Yorùbá ń pè ní 'Subject'?
explanation: The Subject of a sentence is called 'Olùwà'.

q: Kí ni Yorùbá ń pè ní 'Object'?
explanation: The Object of a sentence is called 'Àbọ̀'.

q: Parí òwe yìí: 'Iṣẹ́ ni oògùn _____'?
explanation: The proverb 'Iṣẹ́ ni oògùn ìyà' means work is the antidote to poverty/suffering.

q: Kí ni 'Èmi' nínú gírámà Yorùbá fún ẹni tí ń sọ̀rọ̀?
explanation: 'Èmi' corresponds to the First Person singular.

q: Èwo nínú àwọn wọ̀nyí ni ó jẹ́ orúkọ-àbíkú?
explanation: Names like 'Banjoko' (Stay with us) are given to Abiku children to encourage them to stay alive.

q: Kí ni Yorùbá ń pè ní 'Naming Ceremony'?
explanation: Ìsọmọlórúkọ is the naming ceremony usually performed on the 8th or 9th day.

q: Kí ni ohun tí a ń lò nínú ìsọmọlórúkọ láti dúró fún 'Ìtura'?
explanation: Water (Omi) is used in ceremonies to symbolize coolness and comfort (ìtura).

q: Kí ni àyà-fún-mú nínú èdè Yorùbá?
explanation: Nasal consonants are produced with air passing through the nose.

q: Èwo ni 'Labio-dental fricative' kọ́nṣónáǹtì?
explanation: The consonant 'f' is a labio-dental fricative.

q: Kí ni Yorùbá ń pè ní 'Literature'?
explanation: Literature is translated as 'Lítíréṣọ̀'.

q: Kí ni 'Oriki'?
explanation: Oriki are panegyrics or praise poetry used to highlight lineage or character.

q: Èwo nínú àwọn wọ̀nyí ni kì í ṣe iṣẹ́-òbí Yorùbá?
explanation: Stealing is contrary to 'Omoluabi' values taught by parents.

q: Kí ni Yorùbá ń pè ní 'Good character'?
explanation: Good character is 'Ìwà rere'.

q: Èwo nínú àwọn wọ̀nyí ni ohun èlò kọ̀ǹpútà nínú èdè Yorùbá?
explanation: These are Yoruba terms for screen, mouse/pen, and buttons.

q: Kí ni orúkọ Yorùbá fún 'Market'?
explanation: 'Ọjà' is a market.

q: Kí ni 'Ìrè'?
explanation: 'Ìrè' refers to goodness or blessings.

q: Ta ni ó mọ 'Orí' ní Ìmọ̀-ìṣẹ̀dá Yorùbá?
explanation: Ajalamopin is the potter in heaven who creates the inner heads (Ori).

q: Kí ni Yorùbá ń pè ní 'Destiny'?
explanation: Destiny is known as 'Àyànmọ́' or 'Àpín-orí'.

q: Èwo nínú àwọn wọ̀nyí ni ó jẹ́ kọ́nṣónáǹtì 'fìpè-fagbe' (Voiced)?
explanation: 'b' is a voiced bilabial stop.

q: Kí ni 'Èmi' ń jẹ́ nínú gbólóhùn yìí: 'Èmi ni alága'?
explanation: In 'Èmi ni alága', 'Èmi' is the Subject (Olùwà).

q: Èwo ni fáwẹ́lì iwájú, fífẹ̀ (open front)?
explanation: 'a' is an open front vowel in Yoruba.

q: Mélòó ni fáwẹ́lì 'ẹyọ' (Oral) nínú èdè Yorùbá?
explanation: There are 7 oral vowels: a, e, ẹ, i, o, ọ, u.

q: Kí ni Yorùbá ń pè ní 'Culture'?
explanation: Culture is 'Àṣà'.

q: Èwo nínú àwọn wọ̀nyí ni iṣẹ́-abínibí Yorùbá?
explanation: Farming (Àgbẹ̀) is a primary traditional occupation of the Yoruba.

q: Ta ni Ọba tí ó ní 'Ilé-Ifẹ̀'?
explanation: The Ooni is the traditional ruler of Ile-Ife.

q: Báwo ni a ṣe ń kí ẹni tí ó ń ṣiṣẹ́?
explanation: 'Ẹ kú iṣẹ́' is the greeting for someone working.

q: Kí ni 'Ẹ̀mí' nínú ohun tí ó wà lórí ilẹ̀?
explanation: A person (Èèyàn) is the primary vessel for 'Ẹ̀mí' in human context.

q: Èwo nínú àwọn wọ̀nyí ni ó jẹ́ fáwẹ́lì àránmú 'un'?
explanation: 'un' is a high back nasal vowel.

q: Kí ni ìtumọ̀ 'Àkókò'?
explanation: 'Àkókò' means Time.

q: Kí ni ohun tí Yorùbá ń pè ní 'Family'?
explanation: Family is 'Ẹ̀bí'.

q: Èwo nínú àwọn wọ̀nyí ni kì í ṣe ọ̀rọ̀-asopọ̀?
explanation: 'Èmi' is a pronoun, while the others are conjunctions.

q: Kí ni iṣẹ́ 'Èmi' nínú èdè?
explanation: 'Èmi' expresses the first person identity.

q: Parí òwe yìí: 'Bí ẹ̀mí bá wà, _____ á wà'?
explanation: The proverb implies 'Where there is life, there is hope' (Ìrètí).
